section: Who this applies to
text: [Basque Economic Agreement art. 7](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2002-9969#a7) assigns ordinary employment withholding by where work/services are performed. Where common/Basque work is mixed or its location cannot be determined, use the assigned work centre; telework, foreign work and the specified sea-platform work follow that centre. Apply the competent Basque territory's rules, rather than the employee's annual IRPF residence alone. Pensions/public-system benefits generally follow recipient residence. Directors have payer-domicile and joint corporate-tax allocation rules. State public-sector pay has its separate State allocation and listed institutional exceptions. An employee living in Madrid but assigned to a Bilbao centre for telework does not acquire the State payroll algorithm simply from that residence.

section: Who this applies to
text: [Navarra Economic Agreement art. 10](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-1990-31117#a1-13) similarly assigns ordinary work in Navarra, mixed/indeterminate work by assigned centre and telework/foreign work to that centre. It separately assigns Navarra/local public employees, route transport workers by payer domicile, pensions and directors under their specified limbs, with State public-sector exceptions and compensation provisions. Keep the final annual-residence tax calculation and the withholding administration as separate determinations. Obtain actual work, centre-assignment, payer and residence records.

text: For2026, the annual Navarra dependent-income ceiling is **8,400**, and the specified double family-unit ceiling is **16,800**. Income means taxable income including imputations less fiscally deductible expenses, excluding exempt income; do not subtract base reductions or prior-year loss offsets. Exactly8,400 meets this income gate;8,400.01 fails. The authority's [2025 manual, updated in2026, printed pp227/230](https://www.navarra.es/documents/48192/35409067/Manual%2Bte%C3%B3rico%2Bde%2Bla%2Bcampa%C3%B1a%2Bde%2B2025.pdf/c9e11ce5-ae6f-eb9a-040b-265f1f040525?download=true&t=1775726152475) establishes Navarra's actual annual basis. Applying that same basis to2026 follows the unchanged art62.9 reference and unchanged [2026 IPREM values](https://vivienda.castillalamancha.es/iprem), set in [LPGE31/2022 DA90](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2022-22128#da-90). This does not assert that a2026-income Navarra manual has been published. Keep all age, family, disability, support and apportionment conditions; the amount alone does not establish entitlement.

section: Deadlines and filing
text: **Gipuzkoa’s January filing and payment bridge.** [OF 575/2022, sole article](https://egoitza.gipuzkoa.eus/gao-bog/castell/bog/2022/12/23/c2208406.pdf), effective **24 December 2022**, permanently extends the listed January declaration/self-assessment and associated payment windows to the last day of January. Its model table expressly includes quarterly **110** and monthly **111**. This supplies the operative bridge from the older model-order deadline to the current published **31 January** route; it is not a special one-year concession. Q4 withholding on model110 and December withholding on model111 therefore have a nominal 31 January deadline in the following year. Apply the ordinary weekend/holiday extension and actual direct-debit/payment cutoffs to that nominal date. The order changes the January window, not the separate April/July/October or July-to-September schedules in the table. For both Q4 and December2026, the nominal statutory date is **31 January 2027**, before the relevant calendar adjustment.

section: Deadlines and filing
text: For Bizkaia/Gipuzkoa/Navarra, a subject payment producing zero withholding can require a negative return, while no subject payments does not under the cited general rules. Álava's current art104 is expressly different. Separate paid-income/withholding aggregation from accrued contribution settlement. A payroll certificate and the annual190 must tie to actual payments, correctly valued in-kind amounts and local income-integration fields. Foral penalty/surcharge law is administration-specific; do not copy the State LGT numbers onto a foral assessment without the corresponding provincial/Navarra authority.

section: Penalties and interest
text: Use the procedure law of the administration assessing the liability. Voluntary correction before a qualifying prior request, an underpayment offence and enforced collection are separate events. Interest uses the applicable period's statutory rate and actual accrual days; do not transplant the common-territory monthly surcharge into a foral return.

section: Penalties and interest
text: For Álava/Gipuzkoa, filing an unpaid late self-assessment without the prescribed contemporaneous deferral, instalment or compensation request does not prevent executive collection costs. For all four, preserve notice dates, the exact declaration/self-assessment route, payment evidence, correction period and any reduction conditions. Incorrect refunds, false invoices, information omissions and failure to provide an assessment declaration have their own offences. A percentage range is not an automatic assessment: establish culpability, statutory base, classification and applicable reductions under the cited law.

section: Cross-border points
text: Wage-withholding allocation follows the actual Concierto/Convenio points of connection described above. It is separate from final annual IRPF residence. A nonresident worker, treaty-exempt work or elected specialist impatriate regime needs the corresponding substantive law before replacing an ordinary percentage. Keep foreign tax and social-insurance certificates separately; wage withholding does not settle social contributions.
